ERR_ICD_INCORRECT.name: Incorrect ICD-10 Diagnosis Code
ERR_ICD_INCORRECT.description: The assigned ICD-10-CM code does not match the clinical pathology or diagnosis documented in the medical record (e.g., chronic code billed for acute injury).
ERR_ICD_INCORRECT.prevention_control: Clinical documentation improvement (CDI) reviews and automated acute vs. chronic code cross-checks.

ERR_ICD_SPECIFICITY.name: Diagnosis Code Specificity Mismatch
ERR_ICD_SPECIFICITY.description: An unspecified or low-specificity diagnosis code was billed when specific anatomical, laterality, or manifestation details were explicitly documented in the chart.
ERR_ICD_SPECIFICITY.prevention_control: EHR coding scrubbers prompting coders when unspecified codes (e.g., .9) are selected despite detailed progress notes.

ERR_CPT_INCORRECT.name: Incorrect CPT Procedure Code
ERR_CPT_INCORRECT.description: The billed CPT procedure or E/M code fails to correspond to the service documented (e.g., initial preventive code billed for established patient).
ERR_CPT_INCORRECT.prevention_control: Chargemaster crosswalk validation and patient type verification rules in the practice management system.

ERR_DUPLICATE_BILLING.name: Duplicate Procedure Billing
ERR_DUPLICATE_BILLING.description: The same procedure code was billed multiple times for the same patient, date of service, and provider without appropriate modifier or documented distinct encounter.
ERR_DUPLICATE_BILLING.prevention_control: Automated pre-bill duplicate charge scrubbing rules with hard-stop flags on identical CPT/date combinations.

ERR_EM_UNSUPPORTED.name: Unsupported E/M Service Level
ERR_EM_UNSUPPORTED.description: Evaluation and Management (E/M) code complexity level exceeds what is supported by the documented Medical Decision Making (MDM) or total encounter time under AMA/CMS 2021/2023 guidelines.
ERR_EM_UNSUPPORTED.prevention_control: Provider documentation coaching on MDM criteria and EHR smart templates calculating complexity levels based on chart data.

ERR_SIGNATURE_MISSING.name: Missing Provider Signature / Unauthenticated Record
ERR_SIGNATURE_MISSING.description: The clinical progress note lacks an authenticated electronic signature from the rendering clinician, violating Medicare Conditions of Payment and commercial contract rules.
ERR_SIGNATURE_MISSING.prevention_control: EHR system configuration prohibiting claim generation or bill release until progress notes are locked and signed.

ERR_DOCUMENTATION_MISSING.name: Missing Clinical Documentation
ERR_DOCUMENTATION_MISSING.description: A billed procedure or test lacks any accompanying operative note, diagnostic report, or progress note narrative in the medical record repository.
ERR_DOCUMENTATION_MISSING.prevention_control: Procedural charge capture tied to signed procedure note templates; unlinked charges route to review workqueues.

ERR_SUBSCRIBER_INFO.name: Missing Insurance Subscriber Information
ERR_SUBSCRIBER_INFO.description: Claim lacks valid subscriber identification, policy group number, or relationship code (e.g., minor patient submitted as primary insured).
ERR_SUBSCRIBER_INFO.prevention_control: Mandatory subscriber verification fields in registration software with required guarantor linkage for minors.

ERR_DEMOGRAPHIC_TYPO.name: Incorrect Patient Demographic Information
ERR_DEMOGRAPHIC_TYPO.description: Patient legal name, date of birth, or gender submitted on claim conflicts with payer eligibility file records due to manual transcription errors.
ERR_DEMOGRAPHIC_TYPO.prevention_control: Real-time eligibility (EDI 270/271) verification at patient check-in cross-referencing payer demographic databases with government ID.

ERR_AUTH_REFERRAL_MISSING.name: Missing HMO Referral or Prior Authorization
ERR_AUTH_REFERRAL_MISSING.description: Specialist service, advanced diagnostic imaging, or restricted procedure was performed without obtaining mandatory pre-certification or PCP referral.
ERR_AUTH_REFERRAL_MISSING.prevention_control: Electronic referral tracking module with appointment scheduling hard-stops if authorized referral number is missing.

ERR_MEDICAL_NECESSITY.name: Medical Necessity Documentation Gap
ERR_MEDICAL_NECESSITY.description: The billed service lacks supporting clinical indication or fails Local/National Coverage Determinations (LCD/NCD) for the primary diagnosis linked.
ERR_MEDICAL_NECESSITY.prevention_control: Point-of-care clinical decision support (CDS) in EHR alerting physicians when ordered tests fail LCD medical necessity.

ERR_MODIFIER_APPLICATION.name: Incorrect Modifier Application
ERR_MODIFIER_APPLICATION.description: Failure to append mandatory modifier (e.g., Modifier 25 for significant separate E/M) or improper modifier usage resulting in NCCI bundling denials.
ERR_MODIFIER_APPLICATION.prevention_control: NCCI edit claim scrubber modules screening dual-service claims (minor surgery + E/M) for Modifier 25 documentation criteria.

ERR_UNITS_QUANTITY.name: Incorrect Units or Quantity Billed
ERR_UNITS_QUANTITY.description: Service units billed exceed Medically Unlikely Edits (MUE) thresholds or represent clerical transcription errors (e.g., minutes entered as units).
ERR_UNITS_QUANTITY.prevention_control: Pre-bill claim scrubber configured with CMS Medically Unlikely Edit (MUE) limits and dosage-to-unit conversion calculators.

ERR_COB_ROUTING.name: Coordination of Benefits (COB) Error
ERR_COB_ROUTING.description: Claim was submitted to a secondary or retiree health plan as primary, bypassing the patient's active primary insurer (e.g., Medicare Part B).
ERR_COB_ROUTING.prevention_control: Annual coordination of benefits screening questionnaire at patient check-in and automated Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) screening.

ERR_CALCULATION_BALANCE.name: Incorrect Deductible/Copay/Coinsurance Calculation
ERR_CALCULATION_BALANCE.description: Patient cost-sharing calculation error violating balance-billing laws or double-counting copays and deductibles beyond the contractual allowed amount.
ERR_CALCULATION_BALANCE.prevention_control: Strict waterfall accounting engine in practice management software enforcing Insurer Paid + Patient Due = Allowed Amount.

ERR_SUBMISSION_REJECTED.name: Claim Rejected Due to Incomplete Submission Information
ERR_SUBMISSION_REJECTED.description: Claim file failed HIPAA structural syntax or clearinghouse validation due to unmapped provider NPI or invalid loop qualifiers.
ERR_SUBMISSION_REJECTED.prevention_control: Clearinghouse gateway pre-parser validating ANSI ASC X12N 837P envelope structures and provider taxonomy tables.

QUERY_NO_ERROR.name: Auditing Review – No Error Identified
QUERY_NO_ERROR.description: A billing query or internal audit threshold triggered a review, but thorough clinical chart and guideline inspection confirmed compliant coding.
QUERY_NO_ERROR.prevention_control: Refine internal audit query rules to reduce unnecessary administrative holds on validated encounters.

QUERY_PENDING_DOCS.name: Clinical Documentation Deficiency – Pending Records
QUERY_PENDING_DOCS.description: High-risk prescription or treatment initiated based on external clinical documents (e.g., outside consultation/labs) that have not been uploaded into EHR.
QUERY_PENDING_DOCS.prevention_control: EHR checklist requiring external specialist consult notes and lab panels to be scanned before completing visit encounter.
